newsitem.title: USA: Bloomberg sued over alleged sexual harassment.
newsitem.headline: Bloomberg sued over alleged sexual harassment.

text.p: A former female sales executive Wednesday sued Michael Bloomberg and his privately held companies, charging the media entrepreneur with sexual harassment.

In the lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court in New York, the former executive, Sekiko Sakai Garrison, who now lives in Seattle, alleged "sexual harassment and sexual degredation of women at Bloomberg was pervasive."
The lawsuit also accused Bloomberg individually of harassing Garrison by making offensive remarks.
Garrison, a former sales representative for Bloomberg, was seeking at least $5 million in compensatory damages and at least $10 million in punitive damages, according to court papers.
Neither Bloomberg nor his lawyers were immediately available for comment. The companies are Bloomberg Inc. and Bloomberg LP.
Garrison was employed by Bloomberg from January 1989 until she was fired in May 1995.
